link.title: Isku xirka Akoonka
link.desc: Wuxuu isku xiraa akoonkaaga Pi ee Pi Browser iyo akoonkaaga Google ee biraawsar caadi ah sida isticmaale isku mid ah. Ka dib isku xirka, waxaad ku shaqayn kartaa PC adigoo kaliya ku galaya Google.
link.codeFormTitle: Geli Koodhka Isku xirka Akoonka Pi
link.codeFormHint: Ka dib markaad ku gasho Pi Browser, geli koodhka 6-da lambar ah ee lagu soo saaray shaashadda isku xirka akoonka 10 daqiiqo gudahood.
link.issuerTitle: Soo saar Koodhka Isku xirka Akoonka Google
link.issuerHint: Ka dib markaad ku gasho Google biraawsar caadi ah, geli koodhkan si aad isugu xirto sida isticmaale isku mid ah (wuxuu shaqaynayaa 10 daqiiqo).
